summary: CytomX Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 4 to its existing Collaboration and License Agreement with Regeneron Pharmaceuticals. The amendment extends the program selection period, adds up to eight new collaboration programs, and includes a $37.0 million aggregate target nomination payment for the first two programs nominated. The amendment does not modify royalty obligations. No change of control, M&A, or special situation is present; it is a routine entry into a material definitive agreement for ongoing collaboration.
